title: Signalboard: per-route rollout dashboard for canary, A/B, shadow and auto-rollback signals
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Problem: Engineering and SRE teams running model rollouts (canaries, A/B tests, shadow traffic) lack a single Console view that correlates per-route traffic splits, signal-level metrics (latency, error rate, token cost, quality metrics), trace drilldowns, and whether an auto-rollback policy would have fired. Current observability is fragmented across per-model dashboards, tracing, and ad-hoc spreadsheets, which slows decisions and increases risk for incorrect rollouts.

Why it matters: Faster, confident rollouts reduce incident surface area and time-to-value for new model versions. Teams need a compact way to compare live cohorts, inspect failing requests, and understand economic impact (tokens/cost) alongside quality regressions so they can decide to promote, pause, or trigger an automatic rollback.
proposal:
Build a Console feature called 'Signalboard' that lives on a per-route rollout page and provides: 
- Unified time-series panel with overlays for traffic splits (canary percentage, A/B buckets, shadow on/off).
- Key metric tiles (p50/p95 latency, error rate, token cost per 1k tokens, model quality score tied to eval prompt sets) for each cohort.
- Cohort comparison strip: percentage delta and statistically-significant flag for each metric.
- Request trace list filtered to cohort with one-click link into full tracing UI and reproduction payload.
- Shadow traffic comparator: show distribution of outputs (token length, top tokens, embedding similarity) between live and shadowed model for sampled requests.
- Auto-rollback simulator & timeline: preview whether current rollback rules would have triggered historically and an ability to run the simulator over a selected time-range.
- Exportable snapshot and annotation capability for post-mortem and approvals.

Implementation notes: UI implemented as a Console route component; backend will aggregate per-route metrics from telemetry pipelines and reuse existing trace links. Add lightweight statistical engine in backend to compute significance and historical rollback simulation. Integrate with rollout control API to surface current policies.
scope:
MVP: Signalboard panel embedded in existing rollout detail page; metric tiles for latency/errors/cost; cohort comparison deltas with significance; trace links; rollback simulator run-on-demand. Exclude full export workflow and rich shadow diff visualizations in MVP.

Out-of-scope for MVP: automated remediation UI to edit rollback rules inline, full export/approval workflow, and long-term retention UI changes.
acceptance_criteria: Signalboard is accessible from rollout detail page for all rollout types (canary, A/B, shadow)
Time-series panel displays traffic split overlays and selectable cohorts for the chosen time range
Metric tiles surface p50/p95 latency, error rate, and token cost per 1k tokens for each cohort
Cohort comparison shows percent delta and a simple statistical-significance flag (p < 0.05) for each metric
Clicking a cohort item opens a paginated list of sampled requests with a link to the trace view
Rollback simulator can run over a historical window and indicates whether the configured rollback rules would have fired
End-to-end latency for dashboard queries is <3s for 7-day windows at production traffic levels (non-blocking; SLO for iteration 2 if not met in MVP)
